query: What is the maximum context length supported by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and how many tokens was it pretrained on?
ground_truth: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash supports context lengths of up to one million (1M) tokens and was pretrained on a multimodal corpus comprising 45T tokens.

query: Compare the architectural design of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with GPT-2. How do their attention and decoder mechanisms differ?
ground_truth: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash uses a multimodal Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with Compressed Sparse Attention 2 (CSA2) and cross-layer KV cache reuse, activating 8B/16B parameters conditionally. In contrast, GPT-2 uses a standard dense, decoder-only Transformer with causal masking and full self-attention across 1024 tokens.

query: How does DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash's total backbone parameter scale compare to the largest GPT-2 model?
ground_truth: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash has 552B backbone parameters, whereas the largest GPT-2 model has 1.5B parameters. DeepSeek is approximately 368 times larger in total backbone parameters.

query: Explain Snehil Khokhar's experience with RAG systems and what techniques he implemented in his TRAG project.
ground_truth: In his TRAG (Terminal RAG Engine) project, Snehil combined dense vector embeddings, BM25 lexical search, and Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with FlashRank reranking across a vector database, achieving a 40% reduction in hallucinations.

query: How does DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash achieve KV cache compression and what is its global KV cache size per token in HBM?
ground_truth: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash achieves KV cache compression by combining cross-layer KV cache reuse in Compressed Sparse Attention 2 (CSA2) with FP4 KV caching and SWA Bounded Replay, reducing global KV cache footprint in HBM to 890 bytes per token.

query: Contrast the training corpora used for GPT-2 versus DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash in terms of data scale and modality.
ground_truth: GPT-2 was trained on WebText, an English text-only dataset of 8 million documents (around 40GB). DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash was pretrained on a massive multimodal corpus comprising 45 trillion (45T) tokens spanning diverse textual and visual domains.

query: Summarize the primary architectural contributions and efficiency gains of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.
ground_truth: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash introduces a 552B parameter MoE model with Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) architecture activating only 8B parameters during prefill and 16B during decode. It achieves approximately 4-fold reduction in global KV cache size (890 bytes/token in HBM) using Compressed Sparse Attention 2 (CSA2) with cross-layer KV reuse and FP4 KV caching, and an 8-fold reduction in persistent KV cache via SWA Bounded Replay, supporting contexts up to 1M tokens across a 45T token multimodal training corpus.

query: Summarize the main hypothesis and empirical conclusion of the GPT-2 paper regarding unsupervised multitask learning.
ground_truth: The GPT-2 paper demonstrates that language models trained on diverse web text (WebText) without explicit supervision learn to perform a wide variety of NLP tasks (reading comprehension, translation, summarization, question answering) in a zero-shot manner without requiring task-specific training datasets or architecture modifications as model capacity scales up to 1.5B parameters.
